Summary: enterprise dev tools co building an internal IDE copilot for 1,200+ engineers. Wants fully air-gapped on‑prem appliance with signed model bundles and ability to pin versions per team. 
- Primary ask: IDE plugin (VS Code + JetBrains) + sub-200ms median completion latency for single-line completions, p99 < 800ms under 200 concurrent devs.

- HW sizing discussion: initial estimate: 2 x H100 (or 4 x A100 80GB) per site with 12TB NVMe for model cache and hot KV. Want reference footprint (rack units, power).
- Updates: offline update flow needs signed manifest, SHA256 manifests, and verification via internal HSM. Support for incremental diff bundles is a plus.
- Model/version pinning: ability to pin model hash and rollback quickly; need deterministic config + manifest audit trail for SOC audit.
- Observability: token-level latency breakdown, per-route SLAs, rollout canary for model variant testing.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to buy dedicated HW but wants clear TCO vs cloud.
- Quote from engineering lead: "can't risk developers hitting library-breaking regressions during rollout — strict pin+canary required."
- Legal: legal & procurement flagged model redistribution rights for some Llama-derived weights.
- Security team: requires SOC2/ISO checklist, artifact signing, and audit log retention for 7 years.
